summary_en: Board resolution on capital-cost-conscious management framework. Current ROE below investor-assumed equity cost of capital (7–10%); PBR at 0.7x; market cap relatively low within TSE. Company setting Vision 2028 targets over FY2026–2028 mid-term plan to drive enterprise value, dividend policy revision, and capital efficiency. Specific performance metrics and payout-ratio floor to be disclosed in attached materials.
title_en: Notice Regarding Measures to Realize Management Conscious of Cost of Capital and Stock Price
translation_en_brief: On 26 June 2026, the board of Nippon Tungsten resolved on a management framework to align with cost of capital and stock-price performance. Current analysis shows ROE falling below the investor-assumed equity cost of capital (7–10%) due to FY3/26 extraordinary losses; PBR trading at 0.7x; market cap ranked relatively low within the TSE. The company is establishing a three-year mid-term plan (Vision 2028, FY2026–2028) as a stepping stone toward its foundational long-term vision (Sustainable Vision 2050). The plan targets enterprise-value enhancement and sustainable growth by treating operational constraints—rising raw-material costs, labor expenses—as transformation opportunities. The disclosure indicates specific numeric targets for growth strategy, resource allocation, and capital efficiency, plus dividend policy changes, to be detailed in attached materials. No interim financial or KPI targets are quantified in this announcement.
